# Third-party logos

Used unaltered on the landing page to show which wallets and stablecoins Wagefold works with.

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| walletconnect.svg | github.com/WalletConnect/walletconnect-assets, `Logo/Blue (Default)/Logo.svg` | Official brand asset |
| metamask.svg, trust.svg, coinbase-wallet.svg, safe.svg, usdc.svg, usdt.svg | npm `@web3icons/core@4.0.58`, `branded` set | MIT |

All marks are trademarks of their owners. Follow each brand's usage guidelines (no recolouring, stretching or cropping) and swap in files from the brands' own press kits before a public launch if their guidelines require it.
